cells.rationale: The latest first print (week ending 2026-11-21) was exactly 189,000, well below a roughly 200,000 consensus and the 202,000 prior week, with a four-week average of 196,000 (https://www.financecalendar.com/event/us-initial-jobless-claims-november-25-2026/, 2026-11-27; https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/ICSA, 2026-11-25). A one-week outlier at a historically extreme low usually mean-reverts toward the average, and only 2 of 882 weeks since 2010 were at or below this level. The main risk is Thanksgiving-week seasonal adjustment, which pulled the 2025 equivalent week down to 191,000, and an exact 189,000 repeat would resolve No.

note: Recorded before every entry's cutoff; scored as a separate method.
